ideas.title: Follow the Money: Uncovering the Federal Reserve Scandal
ideas.description: Investigate the use of taxpayer dollars for the renovation of the Federal Reserve's headquarters and potential corruption within the organization
questions: What was the total cost of the renovation?
Were there any irregularities in the bidding process?
ideas.insight: The investigation into Jerome Powell and the Federal Reserve has the potential to uncover a large-scale scandal involving the misuse of taxpayer dollars and corruption within the organization. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of the scandal and hold those responsible accountable.
